# NOAA photo-caption regression fixture

Exact item XML extracted from NOAA's `https://www.noaa.gov/rss.xml` response captured on 2026-09-16, retained in `work/editorial-repair/supply/noaa-news.xml`. Only the channel wrapper is reduced to this one item; title, description HTML, figure/caption, canonical link, GUID and publication date are unchanged. No network access occurs in the test.

This fixture demonstrates a photo-specific credit that must not revoke separately approved text when the app does not use the photo. Explicit article rights and complete safety-policy inspection remain enforced by adjacent tests.
